name: Camphene

pubchem.title: Camphene
pubchem.description: Camphene is a monoterpene with a bicyclic skeleton that is bicyclo[2.2.1]heptane substituted by geminal methyl groups at position 2 and a methylidene group at position 3. It is a widespread natural product found in many essential oils. It has a role as a fragrance and a plant metabolite. It is a monoterpene and a carbobicyclic compound.
